subject: Temporary no-PO onboarding protocol — ByteMetric pilot
messages:
From: Alex Jones <alex.jones@bytemetric.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Sep 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary no-PO onboarding for ByteMetric pilot

Hi Sean / Laura,

We're excited to kick off a short pilot with Redwood (integration team is ready). Our procurement process at ByteMetric is slow right now; procurement says a formal PO could take 3-4 weeks. The pilot needs to start next week — it's a one-off evaluation (estimated spend $8,000) and will be invoiced as a single invoice.

Can Redwood accommodate a temporary no-PO onboarding path for this pilot while we finalize our internal PO? If yes, what evidence or forms do you need from us to qualify?

Attached: ByteMetric_SOW.pdf (SOW for the 2-week pilot)

Thanks,
Alex Jones
Head of Ops, ByteMetric Labs
alex.jones@bytemetric.io | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@bytemetric.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Sep 2028 10:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary no-PO onboarding for ByteMetric pilot

Hi Alex — thanks for the SOW and for the heads-up on timeline.

Short answer: we can often support a temporary invoice-only path for small pilots, but it requires an approved exception from finance + completed onboarding evidence. I'm looping in Priya (procurement) and Marissa (account lead) to scope the exact checklist.

Marissa — can you coordinate a short MAP with ByteMetric (W-9, invoicing contact, tax info) and estimate whether we want to offer a one-time pre-pay, or invoice net-30 under exception?

Priya — what minimum artifacts do you need to approve a temporary no-PO onboarding for a <$10k pilot? If we can standardize a quick checklist, we can keep the pilot timeline intact and revoke the exception once the PO arrives.

Alex — we'll aim to get back within the day with a list.

Cheers,
Sean
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Jones <alex.jones@bytemetric.io>
Date: Tue, 4 Sep 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary no-PO onboarding for ByteMetric pilot

Team — thanks for looping me in. Procurement can approve a temporary no-PO exception for low-value pilots under the following minimum conditions: 

- Completed "Temporary No-PO Request" form (attached): temp-no-po-request-form.xlsx
- External vendor evidence: W-9 (or local equivalent), bank remittance details, and company registration.
- Deal owner attestation: account manager must confirm expected spend, start date, contact for invoicing.
- Risk tier: Low/Medium/High assessment completed (I can run a quick lookup).
- Expiration window: exception granted for up to 90 days or until the formal PO is submitted, whichever comes first.

If the above are provided, procurement will issue a conditional approval that requires finance sign-off for net-30 payment terms. If finance wants prepaid, we will record that as an alternate path.

I will need turnaround from ByteMetric on W-9 + remittance info. Marissa, can you send them the form and confirm who will sign and receive invoices?

Priya
Senior Procurement Manager — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@bytemetric.io>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Sep 2028 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary no-PO onboarding for ByteMetric pilot

Hi Alex — happy to coordinate. Quick MAP and asks so we can get you set up by Monday: 

1) Provide vendor paperwork: W-9 (attached to your reply), company registration, and preferred remittance email.
2) Tell us invoicing cadence: single invoice at completion (preferred) or milestone invoices?
3) PO ETA from your procurement team (approximate is fine).
4) Sign the SOW via DocuSign (link below) to confirm scope and start date.

DocuSign (SOW): https://docu.sign/xyz-sow-byte
Procurement checklist / guidance (internal): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4321

If you can get items 1–2 to me by end of day tomorrow, Priya will run the exception assessment and we'll route to finance for a conditional approval. For spend <$10k we typically approve net-30 with the condition that the vendor emails invoices to billing@redwood.ai and we close the exception once a formal PO is available.

Attachment stubs: None from ByteMetric yet — please reply with W-9 / remittance.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you live.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0112
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Jones <alex.jones@bytemetric.io>
Date: Tue, 4 Sep 2028 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary no-PO onboarding for ByteMetric pilot

All — finance has reviewed and will approve a temporary no-PO exception for this pilot under the following conditions: 

- Procurement (Priya) issues conditional approval once W-9 + remittance details are received.
- Account team (Marissa) to collect vendor invoice to billing@redwood.ai and reference exception ID EXC-2028-091.
- Exception valid for 90 days from approval; any invoices submitted after the window will be rejected.
- Net-30 terms approved; if ByteMetric requests alternate terms, finance must be notified prior to invoice issuance.
- Finance requires copy of signed SOW (DocuSign) and the completed temp-no-po-request-form.xlsx filed in the vendor folder.

I've attached the approval stub: approved_no_po_exception.pdf (internal artifact). Once the required docs are in, procurement can mark the exception as active and operations can onboard the vendor.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
